input: Find swimming, diving and water-safety camps for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: YMCA of Western North Carolina
candidates.note: Camp Kiddos for ages 3–6 includes basic water safety; also operates summer day camps and Camp Watia. Confirmed summer 2026.

candidates.name: Asheville Jewish Community Center
candidates.note: Camp Ruach includes swimming three mornings weekly; summer swim/dive lessons also offered. Camp begins June 14, 2027.

candidates.name: Black Mountain Recreation & Parks
candidates.note: Seasonal outdoor pool offered supervised swim lessons in summer 2026; swim-team season excluded.

candidates.name: Kanuga
candidates.note: General camps with mountain-lake swimming and canoeing, not swim-specialist camps; day camp returned in summer 2025.

candidates.name: The North Carolina Arboretum
candidates.note: 2026 Discovery Camps include outdoor-adventure sessions with waterfall swimming in DuPont State Forest, not dedicated swim instruction.
